name: Trajectory
intent: Preserve a parallel, append-only storyline of (1) the user's original intent, (2) what the Funnel interpreted and requested, and (3) the observed consequence of what was actually built. Let multiple systems estimate alignment using only evidence their equipment/modality can support. Surface the result as a significant forward-moving Trajectory metric with explicit confidence, trend, evaluator identity, and evidence boundaries. Never rewrite old checkpoints to make history cleaner; later corrections are new evidence.

metric.name: Trajectory
metric.meaning: confidence-weighted estimate of intent/result alignment across available assessor reports
metric.warning: Estimate only. Confidence and equipment scope must remain visible; founder judgment is not replaced.

parts.job: preserve the user's request without retroactive cleanup
preserve the blueprint/requirements the Funnel actually emitted
preserve neutral observation of the shipped artifact
store score, confidence, evaluator, modality/equipment, and notes
aggregate only evidence-backed estimates and show direction over time
make corrections additive so the project retains its real intellectual lineage

integrations.convergenceFunnel: Each accepted convergence iteration appends a compatible checkpoint locally and mirrors it to SSD-backed Trajectory app-data when the remembered directory permission is available.
integrations.projectPulse: Registered as a Creation / Component Data tool and hydrates canonical repository checkpoints on open/refresh.

requirements: TR-01 original intent, Funnel interpretation, and built result remain distinct
TR-02 historical checkpoints are append-only by default
TR-03 every system estimate identifies evaluator/equipment and confidence
TR-04 evidence scope cannot silently expand beyond the assessor's modality
TR-05 Trajectory trend compares evidence-backed checkpoints over time
TR-06 unscored/unverified states remain valid instead of inventing certainty
TR-07 import/export preserves portable project memory
TR-08 Convergence Funnel can append checkpoints automatically
TR-09 Project Pulse exposes the component
TR-10 fresh browsers hydrate canonical repository checkpoints instead of presenting an empty ledger
TR-11 SSD-backed local checkpoints remain app-owned and are viewed through MOOR Trajectory
